newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani court orders Zardari's release.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani court orders Zardari's release.

text.p: A Pakistani court on Wednesday ordered the release of Asif Ali Zardari, husband of ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto, after it ruled his detention void, Pakistan People's Party leaders said.
A spokesman for Bhutto's party said a two-judge Division Bench of the Sindh High Court in Karachi had declared Zardari's detention void and ordered his release.
Two advocates of Zardari had taken the court's order to the Landhi Jail, on the outskirts of Karachi, where he was in detention.
